query.description: Absent, null and empty all mean the same thing. Send whichever is natural; the server stores one canonical form.

relation_ids.description: Absent, null and empty all mean the same thing. Send whichever is natural; the server stores one canonical form.

field_ids.description: Absent, null and empty all mean the same thing. Send whichever is natural; the server stores one canonical form.

detail.description: Which metadata categories to return. 'samples' may be given on its own or implied by a non-zero sample_rows. Absent, null and empty all mean the same thing; the server stores one canonical form.

reporting_quarters.description: Absent, null and empty all mean the same thing. Send whichever is natural; the server stores one canonical form.

sample_rows.description: Masked sample rows, 0-10. Requesting one or more IS the request for samples: 'samples' in detail and a non-zero sample_rows mean the same thing, and either alone is honoured. Absent and null mean none.

allOf.title: sample_rows and detail:samples are the same request
allOf.description: A non-zero sample_rows is a request for samples whether or not 'samples' appears in detail, and 'samples' in detail with no sample_rows takes the default row count. Neither form is rejected.
